posts.preview: This morning, I met with the LaRRI Director and Senior Researcher to discuss critical labour, socio-economic and political issues, particularly workers’ participation in legislative processes

LaRRI, established by NUNW, continues to strengthen the labour movement through research, education and leadership development. I also obtained my Labour Diploma through LaRRI at the beginning of my trade union career
Workers are the backbone of our economy, and their voices must be heard at every table where decisions are made
